import numpy as np
# Stowed envelope: chassis 0.9 long, width 0.45, height with folded arms 0.45
L,W,H=0.9,0.45,0.45
print(f"stowed {L}x{W}x{H} vs limit 1.0x0.5x0.5 PASS" if L<=1.0 and W<=0.5 and H<=0.5 else "FAIL")
# Ground pressure: 60kg robot, 4 wheels D=0.2m width=0.15m, contact patch approx width*contact length
# contact length ~ sqrt(D*sink) with sink 0.02m -> sqrt(0.2*0.02)=0.063m
D,b,sink=0.2,0.15,0.02
import math
lc=math.sqrt(D*sink)
A=4*b*lc
p=60*9.81/A/1000
print(f"contact length {lc*1000:.1f} mm area {A*1e4:.1f} cm2 pressure {p:.1f} kPa")
# Traction vs cut force: mu~0.5 loose, traction=mu*W
traction=0.5*60*9.81
print(f"traction {traction:.0f} N vs cut 32.9N margin {traction/32.9:.1f}x")
# Rear tip: wheelbase 0.7m, CG height 0.3m, hopper 15kg at rear overhang 0.3m behind rear axle when tilted
# moment about rear axle: stabilizing robot 60kg at 0.35m ahead, overturning 15kg at 0.3m behind + inertia
M_stab=60*9.81*0.35
M_over=15*9.81*0.30
print(f"stab {M_stab:.0f} Nm over {M_over:.0f} Nm SF {M_stab/M_over:.2f}")
# Stopping: v=0.5 m/s, decel mu*g=0.5*9.81? skid limited ~2 m/s2, d=v2/2a
v,a=0.5,2.0
d=v**2/(2*a)
print(f"stop dist {d*1000:.0f} mm in {v/a:.2f} s")
